learning_outcomes.text: Build a digital-marketing strategy from goals and audience
Map the customer journey and funnel stages
Plan search marketing across SEO and paid search
Plan social and content marketing channels
Plan email, lifecycle and retention marketing
Set up measurement, attribution and analytics
Allocate budget and optimise across channels
Apply testing, governance and ethics in campaigns

integrative_case: A direct-to-consumer brand with a flat growth curve must rebuild its marketing plan. The marketer must set goals, map the funnel, choose channels across search, social, content and email, define KPIs and attribution, allocate a fixed budget, and design an experiment, then defend the plan to the founder on both ROI and privacy grounds.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
